newsitem.title: USA: BHA Group posts higher international sales.
newsitem.headline: BHA Group posts higher international sales.

text.p: BHA Group Inc said Thursday international sales rose sharply in its fiscal first quarter, led by an increase in its electrostatic precipitator parts and service business.

"These markets (electrostatic precipitator) continue to present significant opportunities as customers around the world are demanding the highest quality and advanced technology solutions," James Lund, president and chief executive, said in a statement, adding however that the domestic market remains competitive.
"We continue to manage our resources to most effectively respond to both domestic and international opportunities," Lund said.
Earlier, the company reported earnings for its fiscal first quarter of $0.29 a share, compared with $0.25 a share last year.
BHA said its domestic fabric filter parts and service business grew at a double-digit pace with higher domestic sales of new products. It said it had increased its traditional product offerings.

In addition, new order activity continued strong, BHA said. It said order backlog at December 31, 1996, was a record $43.8 million versus $40.9 million and $35.6 million at September 30, 1996, and December 31, 1995, respectively.
BHA provides replacement parts and maintenance service for industrial air pollution control equipment.
